detail.caveat: Single un-timestamped snapshot per game. No opening line, no closing line, no price.
Present for both sides but published as a single un-timestamped price per game, so the vig is implied by that one price and no line movement can be measured.

gaps.item: Historical betting odds (opening and closing lines, all books)
gaps.why: Without a timestamped line history, no closing-line value and no return on investment can be computed. Every 'edge' claim in the wider betting literature depends on this.
gaps.whatWeHave: One spread/total snapshot per game in nflverse schedules; current-week ESPN odds.
gaps.howToObtain: Licensed historical odds feed (e.g. a commercial sports-data vendor) or a manually archived daily snapshot before every kickoff, stored with a timestamp.
gaps.blocks: ROI claims, vig-adjusted edge, parlay payout modelling, prop-market edges

gaps.item: Player prop prices and settlement rules
gaps.why: Prop combos need the joint price and the exact void/push rules per book.
gaps.whatWeHave: Player weekly box scores (volume outcomes) only.
gaps.howToObtain: A prop market feed with timestamps, or an archived book screen per week.
gaps.blocks: Prop-combo pricing, correlated-prop payout, prop parlay leaderboard

gaps.item: Official starting lineups at kickoff (inactives list)
gaps.why: The injury report is a pre-game designation; the actual inactive list is the truth.
gaps.whatWeHave: Weekly injury report status; depth-chart snapshots; snap counts after the game.
gaps.howToObtain: ESPN summary endpoint inactives per game (endpoint reachable from CI; fetch job queued), or NFL.com game books.
gaps.blocks: Verified 'who actually started' column; the backup-promotion index is currently depth-chart based

gaps.why: The lineup index weights players by snap share, which measures usage, not ability.
gaps.howToObtain: A documented player-value model (e.g. published approximate value) or per-player EPA, both derivable from play-by-play once it is fetched in full.
gaps.blocks: A true 'value of the missing starter' number; today it is a usage-weighted share

gaps.item: Referee and weather effects with adequate sample
gaps.why: Officiating crews and weather are plausible signals but need thousands of games per subgroup.
gaps.whatWeHave: Officials table per game; roof/surface/temp/wind columns.
gaps.howToObtain: Already fetched; needs a dedicated gate with a minimum-subgroup size rule.
gaps.blocks: Officiating and weather strategy families (registered, not yet tested)

gaps.item: Injury report timestamps precise enough for a decision cutoff
gaps.why: A strategy is only usable if the information existed before the bet had to be placed.
gaps.whatWeHave: `date_modified` on 2024+ injury rows; older seasons lack it.
gaps.howToObtain: Use date_modified where present; otherwise fall back to the week boundary and label the row.
gaps.blocks: Any strict 'information available at kickoff-60min' backtest for older seasons
